card.name: Just before a name or number continues
card.fires_on: Positions right before a person's name or a brand name finishes, such as after a quote and 'said', or partway through a capitalized name. Also inside decimal numbers in product names.

modes.label: Before a speaker's name
modes.description: A comma, 'said' or first initial right before a quoted person's name or title.
modes.example: Jack Ablin<<,>> chief investment officer at BMO-Harris

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Partway through a capitalized company or drug brand name.
modes.example: Take GAL<<AF>>OLD on an empty stomach.

modes.label: Decimal points in product names
modes.description: The point inside a number like 7.4 or 4.25 in a fluid product name.

card.writes: It pushes toward name-like endings and away from words about saving, so it mostly adds nothing meaningful.
card.plain: It fires when a person's or brand's name is still being spelled out, just before the rest arrives.
